notes.title: 03-Aug-2024 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I’ve released the HD update in preparation for Ch.2 and Ch.3. (The story has not changed in this patch.)
The resolution has been updated to a beautiful 2560x1440 resolution (2K) and the UI has been revamped. Please enjoy the crisper character sprites and menus.

I also made significant updates to the UI and engine. Things should be more responsive and smoother.

More news to come later!

notes.title: December 8, 2023 Mini-Update
notes.content:
Just a few bug fixes. ^^
We also included a discord link in the game! Come chat with us!
[url=https://discord.gg/yvxKqURVhV]Click here to join our Discord![/url]

After successfully updating, the game will be updated to Version 0.17S. If your version number does not match this, then please refer to this link: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1870220/discussions/0/3881597253358445927/

notes.title: SIMPLIFIED CHINESE LOCALIZATION NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43049045/f431502b4c9972b69d4b866dd2985ce46ae7f857.png[/img]

Hello eveyone,

I'm happy to announce that Empyreal Dawn is now available in Simplified Chinese!

We now support three languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Japanese
[*] Chinese
[/list]

If you haven‘t already, come play Chapter 1 for free! It‘s a full-fledged chapter with voice-acting from start to finish! It‘s a great precursor to Chapter 2 & 3, which will be coming this winter!

If you enjoyed Chapter 1, then please consider supporting us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/blissfulberyl]Patreon[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1870220/Empyreal_Dawn/]Steam[/url]. Your assistance is duly appreciated, and everything goes toward making future chapters bigger and better!

P.S. I'm always happy to receive your messages, so please let me know if you have any feedback or bugs to report! :D

Regards,
Lynn

notes.title: Update notes for 01-Oct-2023 (QoL and bug fixes)
notes.content:
Hullo everyone!

Empyreal Dawn 0.15S has released. We've added several QoL features and fixed a few bugs.
Please have a look at the new "Config" screen, where you can now adjust screen resolution and various other settings.

notes.title: EMPYREAL DAWN EARLY ACCESS IS NOW LIVE!!
notes.content:
Hello all,

I'm excited to announce that [i]Empyreal Dawn[/i] is now live! Well, the demo at least xD.
Playtime for Chapter 1 is estimated to be 3 hours of fully-voiced gameplay.
It's available in [b]English[/b] and [b]Japanese.[/b]

[b]If you enjoyed Chapter 1, please consider purchasing Early Access!! It'll go toward making Chapter 2 and future chapters super awesome! More CGs and more voice acting![/b] ヾ(≧▽≦*)o

Chapter 2 is expected to release in Nov/Dec with more exciting developments, including the introduction of everyone's favorite witch! She's voiced by Ichigo Inuzuka (犬塚いちご), so please look forward to it.

~TOTALLY COOL NEWS~
[b]For our Chinese friends, Chinese (Simplified) localization for Chapter 1 is currently underway![/b] I anticipate it to be ready sometime in October; I'll keep you posted with details. If it goes well, I hope to permanently extend Chinese language support to future chapters!

I would be truly grateful if you could let others know about [i]Empyreal Dawn.[/i]

Sincerely,
Lynn
